contracts.formal_evidence: actual frozen Lean declarations and source proofs; no fresh execution by this reviewer
contracts.hypotheses_and_conclusion: Semiring modules; synthesis∘analysis=I. Compatible E_Y K E_X=K kernels correspond to exactly one global linear map, and encoding preserves composition.
contracts.boundary: Encoded unit is E=analysis∘synthesis, not ambient I. Supplied splitting; no finite dimension or orthogonality.

contracts.formal_evidence: actual frozen Lean declarations and source proofs; no fresh execution by this reviewer
contracts.hypotheses_and_conclusion: Commutative-ring modules; C R=I. Defect(S,T)=C S (I−R C) T R, with coherence and two-stage transport.
contracts.boundary: Nonorthogonal splits allowed. One-pair vanishing is not all-word closure.

contracts.formal_evidence: actual frozen Lean declarations and source proofs; no fresh execution by this reviewer
contracts.hypotheses_and_conclusion: Actual four-block linear dynamics over commutative-ring modules. Prepared powers equal A^n iff all B D^k G vanish. Earlier zero moments make first discrepancy at k+2 equal B D^k G.
contracts.boundary: Prepared hidden initial state is zero. Every-state closure is stronger, equivalent to B=0.

contracts.contract: Finite hidden certificate and canonical split
contracts.formal_evidence: actual frozen Lean declarations and source proofs; no fresh execution by this reviewer
contracts.hypotheses_and_conclusion: Field coefficients; a monic annihilator or hidden dimension d suffices. Test moments k<d or iterates n≤d+1. Split compression uses the actual hidden ker(C).
contracts.boundary: Visible space need not be finite. d=0 covered; whole-map exact tests, not samples.

contracts.contract: All-future behavioral state and reachable minimality
contracts.formal_evidence: actual frozen Lean declarations and source proofs; no fresh execution by this reviewer
contracts.hypotheses_and_conclusion: Commutative-ring all-word invisible submodule N is maximal invariant in ker(O), and dynamics/readout descend to X/N. Over a field exact model image(q) surjects to X/N; finite X gives minimal dimension.
contracts.boundary: Given alphabet, including empty word. Whole model equivalence requires surjective q; unused ambient coordinates remain.

contracts.formal_evidence: actual frozen Lean declarations and source proofs; no fresh execution by this reviewer
contracts.hypotheses_and_conclusion: Field and finite-dimensional X: horizon dim ker(O). Finite enumerated alphabet gives actual finite observation range equivalent to X/N. Certificate generation/intertwining/readout proves ker(q)=N.
contracts.boundary: Infinite alphabet gives bounded length, not finite constraints. Entire model equivalence needs surjectivity. Python JSON is not a Lean proof structure.

contracts.formal_evidence: actual frozen Lean declarations and source proofs; no fresh execution by this reviewer
contracts.hypotheses_and_conclusion: Exact chronological telescoping over commutative rings; normed-field whole-map gain/defect bounds yield all-word budgets. Initial-state/readout defects remain separate.
contracts.boundary: Uniform stability needs common true nonexpansive/reduced contraction norm bounds. No approximate minimality or sampled-vector inference.

contracts.contract: Actual continuous flows and hidden-memory Taylor certificates
contracts.formal_evidence: actual frozen Lean declarations and source proofs; no fresh execution by this reviewer
contracts.hypotheses_and_conclusion: Real Banach spaces, bounded autonomous generators and actual operator exponential. Variation of constants uses actual derivative equation/continuous forcing. Exact all-real-time prepared closure iff zero hidden moments; finite hidden dimension yields finite operator derivatives at zero.
contracts.boundary: No unbounded/time-varying generator claim. Operator derivative k+2 first detects return k; finite sampled times do not certify jets.

contracts.formal_evidence: actual frozen Lean declarations and source proofs; no fresh execution by this reviewer
contracts.hypotheses_and_conclusion: Real Banach generators L,A and bounded q. Actual operator-valued Duhamel integral. For t≥0, supplied flow envelopes yield response budgets; bounded true flow and exponentially stable reduced flow yield uniform error.
contracts.boundary: Exact identities all real time; norm budgets nonnegative time with actual whole-flow bounds, not eigenvalues alone.

contracts.formal_evidence: actual frozen Lean declarations and source proofs; no fresh execution by this reviewer
contracts.hypotheses_and_conclusion: Compatible quotient ker(delta)/(range(A)∩ker(delta)); class zero iff actual source exists. Under delta A=0, all obstructions zero iff exactness. Commuting presentation maps induce actual quotient transport.
contracts.boundary: Whole-range quotient notation needs chain condition. Reflection requires injective induced obstruction map.

contracts.formal_evidence: actual frozen Lean declarations and source proofs; no fresh execution by this reviewer
contracts.hypotheses_and_conclusion: Real inner-product local space, nested projected realized/compatible subspaces. Actual distance squared is obstruction plus inconsistency energy; positive off-kernel whole-map coercivity bounds inconsistency.
contracts.boundary: Residual alone cannot remove obstruction. Finite dimension supplies some positive constant, not uniform conditioning over a family.

contracts.contract: Intrinsic quotient metric, transport and refinement
contracts.formal_evidence: actual frozen Lean declarations and source proofs; no fresh execution by this reviewer
contracts.hypotheses_and_conclusion: Actual range(A) and ker(delta) have orthogonal projections, with delta A=0. Existing quotient norm is isometric to harmonic space with unique minimum local representative. Whole-local-map bounds descend; bounded reverse quotient map reflects quantitatively; fixed-metric refinement has exact energy loss.
contracts.boundary: Nonclosed algebraic quotient can have nonzero class of seminorm zero. Local representative differs from global source; no invented norm or unconditioned reflection.

contracts.formal_evidence: actual frozen Lean declarations and source proofs; no fresh execution by this reviewer
contracts.hypotheses_and_conclusion: Real Hilbert source, real inner-product target and bounded A with complete actual range. Actual inverse of (ker A)⊥→range(A) constructs recovery B with A B=P_range and B A=P_kernel-complement. Public version assumes closed actual range.
contracts.boundary: Minimum-norm least-squares source unique; arbitrary sources differ by ker(A). No supplied inverse or injectivity premise.

contracts.formal_evidence: actual frozen Lean declarations and source proofs; no fresh execution by this reviewer
contracts.hypotheses_and_conclusion: Real Hilbert spaces, bounded A. Closed actual range iff positive coercivity on kernel complement iff bounded B recovers identifiable sources.
contracts.boundary: Actual range, not closure, controls realizability.

contracts.contract: Actual Tikhonov construction, optimality and bounds
contracts.formal_evidence: actual frozen Lean declarations and source proofs; no fresh execution by this reviewer
contracts.hypotheses_and_conclusion: Real Hilbert spaces, bounded A, lambda>0. Coercive normal A* A+lambda I has actual Lax–Milgram inverse; B_lambda is unique minimizer of literal squared-fit plus lambda squared-source norm. Norm B_lambda≤1/(2√lambda).
contracts.boundary: No closed-range premise. Kernel source ambiguity retained; combined identifiable bias/noise is orthogonal to ambiguity, not bias to noise.

contracts.contract: Strong versus uniform regularization and arbitrary data
contracts.formal_evidence: actual frozen Lean declarations and source proofs; no fresh execution by this reviewer
contracts.hypotheses_and_conclusion: Positive parameter tends to zero. Fixed-source strong limit is P_(ker A)⊥g without closed range. With nontrivial filter uniform source-error convergence iff closed range; nonclosed source-error norm exactly one. Fitted data limit is P_closure(range A)v.
contracts.boundary: Original-source limit needs identifiability. Approximate realizability need not actual source; no-source-limit theorem does not assert norm divergence. Converse uniqueness needs nontrivial filter.

contracts.contract: Exact discrepancy selection and accepted-source consistency
contracts.formal_evidence: actual frozen Lean declarations and source proofs; no fresh execution by this reviewer
contracts.hypotheses_and_conclusion: Strict floor infDist(v,range A)<rho<‖v‖ gives unique positive exact root. Accepted rule includes small-data zero or actual Tikhonov source in certified residual band. True data allowance tends to zero, so accepted sources converge to identifiable projection.
contracts.boundary: Selection noncomputable; total selector needs eta>0,tau>1 and feasibility. No separately assumed asymptotic parameter schedule.

contracts.contract: Inexact normal and measured discrepancy certificates
contracts.formal_evidence: actual frozen Lean declarations and source proofs; no fresh execution by this reviewer
contracts.hypotheses_and_conclusion: Actual normal residual gives source correction ≤residual/lambda and image correction ≤residual/(2√lambda). Protected measured band implies NearAccepted. Vanishing genuine noise/source-correction allowances give strong identifiable consistency. Squared certificate uses actual Hilbert norms.
contracts.boundary: Independent measured-evaluation allowance and source/image budgets. Truth allowance external; no generic parser verification.

contracts.formal_evidence: actual frozen Lean declarations and source proofs; no fresh execution by this reviewer
contracts.hypotheses_and_conclusion: Same real Hilbert source/target, whole norm ‖C−A‖≤delta. External true data noise plus limiting identifiable source cap gives eta+delta M. Actual normal residual transport and exact/near accepted sources yield consistency when data/operator/correction allowances vanish.
contracts.boundary: No kernel/rank agreement or projector convergence. Accuracy cannot be inferred from fit or samples; cap concerns limiting identifiable source.

contracts.formal_evidence: actual frozen Lean declarations and source proofs; no fresh execution by this reviewer
contracts.hypotheses_and_conclusion: Candidate noise eta+delta‖x‖. Lower discrepancy and actual Tikhonov optimality self-bound source norm by every true feasible comparison. Supplied accepted sources consistent as errors vanish. Existence requires eta>0,tau>1,delta‖p‖<(tau−1)eta; near-accepted correction also must vanish.
contracts.boundary: Acceptance removes external source cap, not feasibility hypotheses. Noncomputable selection witness takes true A,p and proofs, not an extracted available-data algorithm.

contracts.contract: Exact split calibration and calibrated recovery
contracts.formal_evidence: actual frozen Lean declarations and source proofs; no fresh execution by this reviewer
contracts.hypotheses_and_conclusion: Bounded real frame U R=I; redundant coordinates allowed. Whole calibration truth ‖Y−A U‖≤etaCal and model fit ‖Y−C U‖≤fit give delta=(etaCal+fit)‖R‖. Fixed-frame accepted sources consistent when data/calibration/model-fit allowances vanish; selection also retains delta‖p‖<(tau−1)eta.
contracts.boundary: etaCal externally justified, not individual sample certification. Whole source coverage required; noncomputable theorem-level selection and true kernel ambiguity retained.

contracts.formal_evidence: actual frozen Lean declarations and source proofs; no fresh execution by this reviewer
contracts.hypotheses_and_conclusion: Split frames compose with product analysis norm. Approximate ‖I−U R‖≤rho<1 gives operator allowance ((etaCal+fit)‖R‖)/(1−rho). Partial U(t)=(t,0) admits perfectly agreeing operators with arbitrarily large unseen norm.
contracts.boundary: No useful approximate-frame bound at rho≥1. Reconstruction defect is whole norm, not samples. Proper subspace calibration does not certify global operator.
